2player-tanks-of-war.title: 2Player Tanks of War - Realistic Tank Battle Game
2player-tanks-of-war.description: Get ready for an intense tank battle in 2Player Tanks of War! Challenge your friend across 8 unique maps. The one with the most hits wins! Customize your tank with a galaxy costume and dominate the battlefield. Be strategic, aim carefully, and blow up your friend to claim victory. Are you ready to take on the challenge? Play now and prove your skills!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: 2Player Tanks of War is a thrilling tank battle game where you face off against a friend across 8 unique maps. The goal is simple: blow up your opponent the most times to win!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Choose a map and start the battle.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Aim carefully and shoot to hit your opponent.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: The player with the most hits wins the game!
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Experience the intensity of realistic tank battles with detailed graphics and physics.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Fight across 8 different maps, each with unique challenges and terrain.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Customize your tank with a galaxy costume to stand out on the battlefield.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Plan your moves carefully, aim precisely, and outsmart your opponent to win.
